name: مركز أونتاريو لذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة
subject: Inclusion coordinator interested in Ontario Center
body:
Dear Ontario Center team,

School inclusion is one of your three program areas, and it is the area I know best. In Jordan I achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities in a public school for the first time, and I coordinated inclusion and trained teachers for seven years.

In 2025 I worked in Qatar as a special education specialist within a multidisciplinary team.

I would be glad to support your inclusion and transition work. My CV is attached.

Kind regards,
